integrity: A complete algebraic argument and standalone finite-field checks are provided. Novelty is subject to residual historical priority risk. The Jacobian-square isogeny is cited from Bruin and Kulkarni, not claimed as new. No independent external mathematical validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Literal (u,v) pairs over finite fields of odd characteristic and smooth members only; no isomorphism-class counts or full zeta functions; identical calculations in unindexed prior literature cannot be excluded.
title: Four Frobenius types in a two-parameter genus-four Jacobian-square family
